query: Help me turn my notes on the permissions settings redesign into a portfolio case study. I was the only designer, worked with a PM and 5 engineers for 6 months. I don't have hard metrics, just some usability test results and positive feedback from CS.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/case-study-templates.md and uses the outcome-first structure with a TL;DR stating problem, role, and result
Writes 2-4 key decisions with options, evidence, call, and trade-off
Uses proxy metrics (task success, time on task, SUS, ticket signals) clearly labeled as proxies and does not invent numbers
Flags missing information as open gaps and includes visual list with insight captions and alt text

query: Can you critique my case study? It's about 3,000 words, starts with a long background section, and has 20 screens at the end. Hiring managers don't seem to get past the first scroll.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/writing-and-review.md and runs the 60-second skim test first
Scores the case study with the 1-4 rubric across all criteria
Gives top 5 fixes most impactful first, each with a rewritten example (e.g. outcome-led headline, insight captions)
Recommends cuts toward 800-1,500 words and replacing the gallery with a few annotated before/after screens

query: I have a 45-minute portfolio review for a senior product designer role at an enterprise SaaS company next week. My best project is under NDA. How should I structure the presentation and what questions should I prepare for?
expected_behavior: Provides the 45-minute deck outline with slide-by-slide timing and Q&A buffer
Applies NDA treatment: anonymize company, redraw or abstract screens, use relative metrics, check with employer
Lists likely interview questions with the headline-context-action-result-reflection answer structure
Emphasizes decisions, trade-offs, stakeholder influence, and enterprise complexity suited to a senior role
